title: GOLD case
description: One capability smoke-test case. The uid is a truncated SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of query + non-empty expected values (see src/goldset/canonical.py); tools/check.py enforces that it is truthful.

id.description: Stable lineage id (the sheet's test_id, e.g. '1-030'). Survives edits; identifies the test's intent across versions.

uid.description: Content hash of query + expectations. Changes on every semantic edit; results are keyed on it.

status.description: Lifecycle: ready | todo | done | not doing (lowercased on import).

group.description: Capability grouping (test_group); also the case's directory.

query.description: The user prompt sent verbatim to the agent.

expected.description: Expectations, keyed without the 'expected_' prefix. Every key participates in the uid. Values are strings exactly as the harness consumes them.

notes.description: Non-scored annotations (status_reason, aoi_type, class/value scratchpads). Never hashed: triage commentary must not mint a new version.
